summary: Attempt a normal close that can be cancelled.

target.notes: Requires an ElectronCompat native-window abstraction so object lifetime and window events remain observable.

caveats: Must not be lowered to unconditional Dispose/Destroy because Electron close can be prevented.

tests.name: normal close
tests.expected_behavior: close lifecycle runs and the window is destroyed if not cancelled

tests.name: cancel close
tests.expected_behavior: window remains open when the close event is prevented
